decision_predictions.explanation: CASE-4D5C964234 resolves via its own three direct observations only: the bowler's-end signal log records a No-ball call (r25fact_36cd5fcc494093e0a42b), the delivered ball touched neither the striker's bat nor person (r25fact_d78eb7e7122ae6c76bc2), and 0 runs were completed before the recorded terminal event (r25fact_9bf66f1104392445c58f). Baseline: the No-ball call fixes delivery_status = NO_BALL; per digest 2330504C the call adds one No-ball extra, and with no bat/person contact and 0 completed runs there are no batter runs, byes, leg-byes or boundary allowance. Digest 84BC5D82 debits the bowler with batter runs plus No-ball/Wide extras, so bowler_runs = 0 + 1 = 1; total_runs = 1 matches the ledger. Digest FAE4D777 excludes a No-ball from the six valid balls, so counts_in_over = false. With no wicket event recorded, pre_wicket_ball_state = NOT_APPLICABLE and dismissal = NONE; no revision or lock-time contest exists for this token, so active_source = DIRECT_OBSERVATION. Counterfactual (single atomic change: no_ball_called -> 'the bowler's-end signal log records no No-ball call'): the No-ball call is removed while contact (neither bat nor person), running (0 runs) and the absence of appeal/wicket facts are unchanged. The delivery is then an untouched, scoreless delivery: delivery_status = WIDE, scored as one Wide extra per the wide-extra account, batter_runs = 0, bowler_runs = 0 + 1 = 1 (Wide extras are debited to the bowler per digest 84BC5D82), total_runs = 1, counts_in_over = false (a Wide is not a valid ball), dismissal = NONE, pre_wicket_ball_state = NOT_APPLICABLE, active_source remains DIRECT_OBSERVATION. Source-selection status and all other incident facts are held constant; only the call observation changed.

Locator chain: CASE-2370BE579C -> OBS-F5A69F82 (r25loc_71bacf908c9ceb116957) -> packet PKT-7F2BA976, logged at 13:38 in over 37 (r25loc_581a624261e04d55719b). All incident facts are drawn only from that time/over. BASE WORLD. (1) Contact: the synchronized observation states the delivered ball touched neither the striker's bat nor person (r25fact_fc030d160694cb99d2d7). (2) Call: the bowler's-end signal log records no No-ball call (r25fact_284515570532408681a0); the No-ball-call observations belong to other tokens (OBS-80B5AE91, OBS-C3BA0E79, CASE-4D5C964234) and are excluded. (3) Wicket: the wicket-keeper alone put down the wicket (r25fact_6a0b278eb40c34fcf057), by a method satisfying the wicket-put-down record (r25fact_f314495f3a68542b6d33). (4) Running: the striker was not attempting a run at the wicket event (r25fact_838d092829aa1ad87751) and was out of ground (r25fact_5394ede0bd2cba4b9c80). (5) Appeal: the fielding side appealed within the recorded window (r25fact_858041e39ceed5ae1aa4). (6) Boundary: no boundary fact is recorded for 13:38/over 37; all boundary observations belong to 16:48/over 5 or 11:27/over 22 and are excluded, so boundary_allowance = 0 and movement_runs_before_boundary_allowance = 0. (7) Ball state: no dead-ball fact is recorded for this incident, so pre_wicket_ball_state = LIVE. Decision: by digest 70C1B772 (r25rule_5b71d739bd3fca1cb306), Run out requires the ball in play, the batter out of ground, and that ground's wicket fairly put down; all three hold, and the wicket-put-down record is satisfied (r25fact_f314495f3a68542b6d33). Stumped additionally requires the wicket-keeper alone to put down the wicket with no other fielder's intervention (digest 0D3690D8, r25rule_cf5a75acc47f51ea35e5); the event sheet records exactly that (r25fact_6a0b278eb40c34fcf057). The striker was not attempting a run, so the dismissal is Stumped rather than Run out. The appeal requirement (digest 6BFBC1FF, r25rule_fcab34943c47745f182f) is met. With no No-ball call and no bat/person contact the delivery is LEGAL and counts in the over (digest C3CEE167, r25rule_f159f657f1c913962a3d; digest FAE4D777, r25rule_cf5a75acc47f51ea35e5). No runs were completed and no boundary is recorded, so the total is 0; the bowler is debited with batter runs plus No-ball/Wide extras only (digest 84BC5D82, r25rule_47c38b83385a8682c0bc), hence bowler_runs = 0. Ledger verification: 0 = 0. COUNTERFACTUAL WORLD (single atomic change: no_ball_called := 'the bowler's-end signal log records a No-ball call'; source-selection status and all other incident facts unchanged). The delivery becomes a No ball (digest 2330504C, r25rule_ee92e3754e7dfd4aa3e1): it adds one No-ball extra, is excluded from the six valid balls of the over (digest FAE4D777, r25rule_cf5a75acc47f51ea35e5), so counts_in_over = false and total_runs = 1, all debited to the bowler (digest 84BC5D82, r25rule_47c38b83385a8682c0bc). The dismissal is void: after a No ball, Stumped is unavailable (digest 68237E0B, r25rule_056e42c08fc65e9e11b2), and the striker, though out of ground and not attempting a run, is not Run out when the wicket-keeper alone puts down the wicket (digest 448ED153, r25rule_056e42c08fc65e9e11b2). Ledger verification: 1 = 1; bowler_runs = 0 batter runs + 1 No-ball extra = 1. State fields: active_source = DIRECT_OBSERVATION (the changed value is read directly from the synchronized observation; no revision or lock-time selection is needed for this field); effective_delivery_status = NO_BALL; movement_runs_before_boundary_allowance = 0 (unchanged; no running or boundary fact for this incident); boundary_allowance = 0 (unchanged); pre_wicket_ball_state = LIVE (unchanged; no dead-ball fact is recorded for this incident, and the wicket event itself does not kill the ball for scoring purposes here).

No dismissal is completed (no catch completion against a batter is recorded; the fielder retained control and the ball crossed the boundary), so dismissal=NONE and the 4 runs are batter runs. With two signed review entries (rev 4 and rev 7) now about the same observation, BBFF51AD selects the greatest revision number, so rev 7 (no boundary contact before control) remains active — active_source becomes HIGHEST_REVISION. All other facts unchanged: catch still completes (control obtained per r25fact_9ad2b6ccd258848c9c1e), boundary allowance still 4, delivery still LEGAL. The decision record is therefore unchanged; only the state's active_source changes.

With a fair put-down, ball in play, batter out of ground and a valid appeal, Law 70C1B772 (Run out) is satisfied → RUN_OUT. The boundary occurred after the wicket; under Law C6325106 a later boundary after the ball's terminal wicket event cannot score, so boundary_allowance = 0 and only the 1 completed run counts. Run out requires a fairly put down wicket, so the dismissal fails → NONE; all other facts (1 run, legal delivery, live ball, appeal, post-wicket boundary) unchanged; ledger and bowler debit remain 1.
